summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival RPG spanning Level 0, the mall, The Hub and authored destinations; player.state carries progression, gear, quests, run choices and resume location. Shared registries and handlers coordinate global play, while authored cell scenes and local simulations compose spaces and stories. Level 178 is Kyoto Dreams; Savi True Focus adds a runtime helper controller, and the solo tutorial now teaches through staged beats plus an in-game Field Guide.

migrationNotes: Global sim.js runs every 250ms with a shared 40-eligible-object budget across live places; queues are machine-local snapshots, refilled when empty and discarded when a place has no players. It skips player roots and local-audience objects.
